verdicts.tldr: chromeShot's filepath.Abs block is four lines Chrome and os.Stat both already resolve the same way
verdicts.details: chromeShot passes out to two places only: --screenshot= and os.Stat. Chrome is started with exec.Command and no cmd.Dir, and nothing in the package calls os.Chdir, so the browser inherits the Go process's working directory and resolves a relative --screenshot= against exactly what os.Stat(dst) would. filepath.Abs therefore only Cleans the path, and its error return fires only when os.Getwd fails. Deleting the block takes shots.go from 213 to 209 lines with go vet clean and the package's tests green. Fix: drop the Abs block and pass dst to --screenshot= and os.Stat.
verdicts.evidence: Head, judge scratch worktree at ecf7af0f2, chrome at /usr/sbin/google-chrome-stable. grep -rn 'os.Chdir|cmd.Dir|.Dir = ' misc/gnopreview/*.go: no match. Finder's fixture rerun from the file as zz_b4_test.go: with the block, 'relative dst landed at /tmp/TestChromeShotRelativeDst473451620/001/zz-rel.png, 5654 bytes'; with the block deleted and out replaced by dst, 'relative dst landed at /tmp/TestChromeShotRelativeDst530631153/001/zz-rel.png, 5654 bytes'. Same cwd-relative landing, same byte count. 'wc -l shots.go' 213 -> 209; 'go vet .' exit 0; 'go test .' ok github.com/gnolang/gno/misc/gnopreview 0.418s.
verdicts.verify_by: go test -run TestChromeShotRelativeDst ./... with the block present and with it deleted, comparing the file location and size; grep -rn 'os.Chdir|cmd.Dir|\.Dir =' misc/gnopreview/*.go for a chdir anywhere in the package

verdicts.tldr: a merge-base render that failed leaves the comment showing one unlabelled screenshot and no word that there is no baseline
verdicts.details: renderBase returns a nil *Crawler on every failure path — startGnodev error, waitReady timeout, base.Run error, base.Write error, and an empty -base-root — each reporting only to stderr, while the newRealms map it returns marks only realms absent from cfg.baseRoot. A realm that does exist at the merge base therefore arrives at ScreenshotPairs with base == nil, so the shots.go:88 'if base != nil' guard is skipped, Before stays empty and New stays false. pairGrid's 'if p.Before == ""' branch then emits the after image with note == "", so the reader gets the realm name, one picture, and nothing else; the two-column 'before — merge base' / 'after — this PR' table that is the tool's whole product is gone with no explanation. The code already states this invariant for the New flag at shots.go:39-43 ('claiming a realm is new when we simply did not look would be a lie in the comment') and does not keep it for the silent case. Fix: carry the baseline outcome on ShotPair and have pairGrid say 'baseline unavailable — the merge-base render failed' when Before is empty and New is false.
verdicts.evidence: Finder's fixture rerun from the file as zz_b5_test.go in the judge scratch worktree at ecf7af0f2: both tests PASS. The failed-baseline body it printed, verbatim: '**`gno.land/r/x/leaf`**' then '' then '**Changed realms (1)**' — no 'before', 'merge base', 'baseline', 'compare' or 'unavailable' anywhere, and the closing speaks only of the static snapshot. Read chain confirming the fixture is the state main.go leaves: main.go:246/252/267/271/275 return nil with newRealms, shots.go:88 gates the before shot on base != nil, comment.go:106-114 renders the lone image with note empty unless p.New.
verdicts.verify_by: go test ./... -run 'B5Baseline|B5NewRealm' -v in misc/gnopreview at ecf7af0f2 with the artifact test: expect the comment to name the missing baseline, observe a body byte-identical to the New-realm body minus its <sub> note

verdicts.tldr: the snapshot's tab layout is spelled four times in comment.go and once in urlToFile, and no test ties them together
verdicts.details: urlToFile owns the mapping from a gnoweb path to a static file and is the only place that writes the '_t' segment (crawl.go:503). comment.go never asks it for the tab pages: tabs at line 154 concatenates '/_t/source/' and '/_t/help/' onto the base URL, and Index at line 174 concatenates the same two suffixes onto a file path, four hand-spelled copies of a layout one function decides. Changing the scheme in urlToFile and updating crawl_test.go's goldens — which is the whole of what an author changing it would touch — leaves the package green while every source and help link in the posted comment points at a directory the crawler no longer writes. Routing both sites through urlToFile costs six lines and leaves the emitted markup byte-identical. Fix: add a tabDir helper calling path.Dir(urlToFile(u+"$"+query)) and use it at both sites.
verdicts.evidence: Judge scratch worktree at ecf7af0f2. Mutation: sed -i 's|"_t", slug(query)|"_tab", slug(query)|' crawl.go and sed -i 's|_t/|_tab/|g' crawl_test.go, then 'go test .' -> 'ok github.com/gnolang/gno/misc/gnopreview 0.005s', whole suite green, while comment.go still holds two lines with '_t/' and tabs() still emits 'https://e.test/pr-1/r/x/leaf/_t/source/' against a crawler now writing r/x/leaf/_tab/source/index.html. The coupling test I added fails under that mutation ('tabs() has no link to "https://e.test/pr-1/r/gnoland/home/_tab/source/"') and passes at head. Rewrite measured: comment.go 196 -> 202 lines, go vet clean, TestCommentRealms — which pins https://example.test/pr-7/r/x/leaf/_t/source/ — still PASS, so the output is unchanged.
verdicts.verify_by: grep -n '_t/' misc/gnopreview/comment.go (two lines, four occurrences) against grep -n '"_t"' misc/gnopreview/crawl.go (one line, 503, inside urlToFile); then confirm no test asserts the two agree: grep -n '_t/' misc/gnopreview/*_test.go
